title: Paradigmatic Model Node
description: A node of the grounded-theory paradigm model. Produced by `14-paradigmatic-model`. The set of nodes + arcs forms `3-analysis/model.canvas` + `3-analysis/model.md`.

role.description: Paradigmatic role of the node. causal_condition — what triggers the phenomenon. context — the circumstances. intervening_condition — modulators (that enable or block actions). action_strategy — what the respondent does. consequence — the consequences of actions.

name.description: Node name — a process label (for example, 'a lack of clear cues to choose by'), not a taxonomic category.

linked_themes.description: Themes the node draws on. Often, but not always, the same as a theme from a category.

description.description: 1–3 sentences on what the node means in this model.

supporting_segments.description: Pin to the data. A node with no pinned segment is an interpretation without evidence and is not allowed.

confidence.description: Confidence that the node exists. low = a hypothetical node (supported by 1–2 respondents); high = confirmed many times over.

is_hypothetical.description: Explicit flag for a hypothetical node. true = the node is needed for the model but the data is thin; it must be marked in `model.md`.

canvas_position.description: Node coordinates on the Obsidian canvas. Optional — controls the visual layout.

arc.title: Paradigmatic Model Arc
arc.description: An arc between model nodes. Stored in `model.md` under the 'Main arcs' section or in `model-arcs.v1.json`.

kind.description: causes — causal (solid line). modulates — supports/amplifies (dashed). blocks — impedes (dashed with a marker). co-occurs — co-occurs without causality.

claim.description: A statement in the form 'under condition X, in context Y, action Z happens with consequence W'.
